items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: So, Nora, me and Nora were separated together with old man McCollum, see, here in New Orleans.

ctx.x: On trombone. That's what was right. You're right about that, sir. So, that time, Lewis was in Chicago then, doing good. That's when they had to broke up. See, they had to broke up. I know why they broke up. See, Lewis broke up on kind of there. Lewis was a young man, and Joe was, that was Joe's girlfriend. So, Lewis got in there in Tukli, in Maryland, and that's quite natural. They had to separate, you understand? Yeah. So, that's why. So, Nora, me and Nora were separated together with old man McCollum, see, here…
